name: @cowork/watcher
description: WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR: the watcher package (owner B; src/diagnose/ belongs to C). It runs on ONE machine for the whole team: merges every agent's wip snapshot, runs tsc + vitest, finds the clashing pair, reports conflicts and starts Droid diagnoses. Runs with tsx because it imports the generated SpacetimeDB bindings. Dependencies come from the root `npm run setup`.
